opening.argument: The speaker presents Hashflare power as a way to build daily revenue and reinvest that income, while directing viewers to register through a referral link. The proposed entry is roughly $300, with a purchase screen showing 2.6 TH/S and a $312 total. He also discusses increased returns if Bitcoin prices rise and pairs registration and partner links with a “200 satoshi every hour” claim. The video therefore frames paid mining power as an opportunity to earn and grow online income, while showing the order at confirmation stage. A site notice simultaneously warns of a temporary increase in BTC withdrawal fees and possible processing delays, limiting what can be concluded about any completed withdrawal or realized return.
